page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Flex.2-8 is an arm64-based compute instance built on the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor platform. The configuration supplies 4 dedicated physical cores clocked at 3.6 GHz, running one thread per core for a total of 4 vCPUs. Because each vCPU maps to an independent physical core rather than a shared hyperthread, execution pipelines avoid resource contention from sibling threads.

The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include integrated local disk storage, meaning persistent storage requirements must be handled via attached cloud block storage or remote storage solutions. Acceleration hardware is omitted, with 0 GPUs onboard. Network provisioning includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

This hardware balance provides high compute density relative to its memory footprint. It delivers a cost-efficient profile for CPU-driven tasks that do not demand extensive RAM pools or local IOPS arrays. The instance is suited for ARM-targeted continuous integration runners, code compilation, containerized microservices, distributed worker nodes, and scalable web servers.
